notes: R400 000 determined value, maintenance plan included in the purchase price: 3.25% = R13 000 a month (G21 p. 5). Employer satisfied that business use is at least 80%: only 20% of the benefit is remuneration for PAYE = R2 600 (BRS code 4582 p. 105). Taxable remuneration 42 600; x12 = 511 200; tax = 79 998 + 31% x (511 200 - 383 100) = 119 709; less 17 820 = 101 889; /12 = 8490.75. The calculator taxes the full R13 000. Same named limit as fb-vehicle-3802-35pct-80pct-taxed (80/20 on the vehicle benefit is the BRS 4582 wording, not a G21 sentence). SDL AND NET ADDED (FB review round 2): SDL: the SDL-flagged 3802 counts at its PAYE share (SDL Act s3; Fourth Schedule para 1; G21 p. 5): 1% x R42 600 = R426.00. Net = R40 000 cash (the vehicle is non-cash) - PAYE 8 490.75 - UIF 177.12 = R31332.13; the benefit is non-cash, so it is in neither gross nor net pay. These two figures are derived from the cited rules and the sourced PAYE and UIF, not read from a payslip.
